_note: Transcribed by hand from the item tooltips on the Relic Gears tab of the MVP sheet, which only exist there as screenshots. A few tooltips are cut off at the bottom in the source, so the flavour text can end mid sentence. The screenshots are deliberately not shipped with the site; re-check against the sheet if it is updated.

items.name: Assassin Dagger
effect: Envenom and Flashing Steel have a chance to inflict Bleeding
Chance: 50% + 10% per skill level
Poison Duration on Envenom -10s
items.flavour: A dagger used by an ancient sect of assassins.

items.name: Guardian Claymore
effect: Bleeding Damage +30%
Damage taken from Bleeding enemies -30%
items.flavour: A large sword wielded by particularly aggressive guardians of an ancient king.

items.name: Brocca
effect: Vulnerable Potency +30%
items.flavour: A primitive, simplistic spear developed by the Wootans for hunting the tough monsters of the Umbala Jungle.

items.name: Sea Breeze Ukulele
effect: Synchronic Strike and Vicious Verse Damage +30%
SP Cost of Heroic Hymn, Ardent Anthem and Devastating Descant +1000%
Removes the effects of Heroic Hymn and Ardent Anthem on equip
Silences the user for 10 seconds on unequip

items.name: Floral Microphone
effect: Synchronic Strike and Vicious Verse Damage +30%
SP Cost of Heroic Hymn, Ardent Anthem and Devastating Descant +1000%
Removes the effects of Heroic Hymn and Ardent Anthem on equip
Silences the user for 10 seconds on unequip
items.flavour: A surprisingly modern piece of kit.

items.name: Focus Staff
mastery: Magical Attunement mastery: Variable Cast Time -3%
effect: Fixed Cast Time -0.5s
items.flavour: A staff set with a powerful magical gem that draws the user's mind into itself, allowing unprecedented speed and precision in uttering their incantations.

items.name: Stardust Blade
effect: Lash Out inflicts the Stun Status for 1 second instead of knocking back
items.flavour: A glittering blade rumoured to be forged out of an otherworldly metal. Its shine seems to captivate enemies with each swing.

items.name: Cinquedea
effect: Enables use of Rolling Cutter Lv1
items.classes: Swordman, Mage, Merchant, Thief and Acolyte classes
items.flavour: A wide-bladed dagger designed to be used for cutting and slashing rather than stabbing or piercing.

items.name: Book of Tides
effect: Enables Lash Out at the same level as the learned level of Lunar Protection
Enables Mass Entrap at the same level as the learned level of Lunar Glow
items.flavour: A book detailing ancient wisdom of the ocean, written by the civilization that sunk beneath the waves in what is now known as Byalan.

items.name: Dress Sword
effect: Casting Provoke autocasts it again on all targets within range
items.flavour: A dress sword used by an ancient military commander. Though it likely saw little combat, it gives the wearer a distinct aura of majesty.

items.name: Bloody Axe
effect: Mammonite inflicts the Bleeding Status
items.flavour: A heavy axe, just barely wieldable with one hand, that always seems to be dripping with blood.

items.name: Doom Slayer
effect: For each level of Equipment Maintenance, Weapon Maintenance and Armor Maintenance: Crit Rate +2 and ASPD -1
items.flavour: An absolutely massive two-handed axe plundered from Orc Dungeon.

items.name: Crossbow
effect: Double Strafe knocks enemies back 3 cells
items.flavour: A sturdy crossbow that packs a remarkable amount of stopping power, though its impact is perhaps not as focused as it could be.

items.name: Loki's Nail
effect: For each level of Flashing Blades learned, Grimtooth and Sonic Blow have a 20% chance to inflict the Bleeding Status
For each level of Toxic Blades learned, Bleeding Damage +5%
For each level of Rejuvenating Blades learned, Bleeding Duration +1 second

items.name: Void's Burden
effect: For each refine: ASPD +1, Crit Damage +3%, Critical Hits gain 3% Defense Pierce, All Stats -1, Potion Effectiveness -5% and SP Regen -5%
items.flavour: A two-handed sword found in the depths of Niflheim that emanates what you can only describe as an absence.

items.name: Desert Twilight
effect: Main hand: Damage to Vulnerable enemies +3% per Refine
Off hand: Blind Potency +20
Combo with Sandstorm: Desert Blades Level +1 for every 2 Refines on the set

items.name: Sandstorm
effect: Main hand: Damage to Blind enemies +3% per Refine
Off hand: Vulnerable Potency +20%
Combo with Desert Twilight: Desert Blades Level +1 for every 2 Refines on the set

items.name: Black Forest Boots
effect: Physical Attacks and Skills have a 30% chance to inflict Slow
Magical Attacks have a 30% chance to inflict Chill
Max HP/SP -10%
items.flavour: Traditional boots once worn by troops of the Schwarzwald Republic. They were masters of making the terrain of the battlefield fight for them.

items.name: Novice Breastplate
effect: Max HP +100
Max SP +25
Combo with Novice Hat, Manteau and Shoes: EXP Gain +20%
items.flavour: A sturdy breastplate once used by a novice adventurer.

items.name: Jungle Boar Hide
effect: Damage taken from Bleeding, Burning and Poison -30%
items.flavour: A cloak fashioned from the hide of a massive jungle boar. Exceptionally rare considering that the jungle boars have been extinct for ages.
